cause: Tab bar hide grows the viewport from 500.74075 to 593.18518 dp, clamps bottom offset from 408.88889 to 316.44446 dp, and the direction-only hook previously revealed navigation on this layout adjustment.
fix: Ignore offset changes accompanying a viewport height change; re-anchor the direction run at the new position.
scope: Android regular ScrollView callers. DraggableFlatList bare-offset callback does not include viewport height and remains separately unverified.
